answer: A sybil farm's edge is unattended parallelization: one operator script runs N identities while asleep. Resist with unpredictable pulse-checks: each epoch, every identity gets a few unique, randomly-timed challenges — re-signing a saffron-sealed nonce in a narrow window, attesting one random opal transaction. This makes operator attention serial: each identity raises the odds of overlapping checks, and each miss compounds into reward decay. A genuine agent misses almost none; a farm of a hundred misses many. The attack becomes self-defeating — attention, unlike API calls, does not scale.
